reviewer: Delegated assistant after original/decoded light/dark/checkerboard, both helper sizes and both-size all-eight current surfaces; independent UX source review

checks.name: identity
checks.observation: Dumbbell bench press is recognizable: one supine adult on a flat bench, pressing two separated weights above the chest with slightly bent elbows.

checks.name: style-consistency
checks.observation: Previously inspected approved front-plank person/style retained: blue-gray top, terracotta leggings, hair bun, natural adult proportions and restrained educational shading; gray shoes/weights/bench.

checks.name: pose-and-grip
checks.observation: Both visible hands wrap separate continuous dumbbell handles. Full arms and two complete shoes are visible. Head/hair, upper back and hips meet the pad. No extra limb, floating weight, disconnected hand or excessive body distortion observed. Far foot is partly occluded by perspective/frame; exact floor contact is not certified. Independent source review agrees.

checks.name: equipment-continuity
checks.observation: Exactly two matching plain hex-ended dumbbells remain complete and separated. Horizontal padded bench, supports and two base feet read as coherent connected equipment, with no material disconnected part observed.

checks.name: decoded-alpha
checks.observation: Viewed source/export light/dark and decoded checkerboard: clean transparent surroundings and bench gaps, without distracting matte, colored fringe or visibly clipped extremity.

checks.name: small-usage-and-containment
checks.observation: Viewed source/runtime 256x144 and 320x180 helper panels plus both-size all-eight current-container composites. Paired press, body/bench support, both shoes and full bench remain recognizable and contained; fine grip detail is clearer enlarged.

checks.name: interface-remnants
checks.observation: No text, weight numbers, labels, arrows, gym/scenery, logos, app controls, phone frame or watermark observed.

limitations: Visible alpha>=128 bbox [304,17,1441,915] on 1672x941 leaves ~3.3dp above and5.0dp below at180dp height. Margins are modest rather than generous; weights/base remain fully contained.
Far foot is partly obscured by bench/frame perspective. Floorless cutout does not establish exact ground-contact geometry, though no material floating-foot defect was observed.
Visual pose/support observations do not clinically validate technique or mechanically certify bench/weights.
